A plain guide to travel paperwork for a special spell
This page is for you

Travel paperwork for companion animals

When you prepare to travel with a companion animal, the Companion Animal Travel Desk helps make the paperwork feel manageable. The goal is to keep the process clear, respectful, and as calm as possible for both you and your animal. Aurelia Skyways works to support dependable companion travel, and that starts with careful document review.

Most trips need a set of records that show the animal is ready for travel and that the journey can be arranged safely. These records may include health details, ownership information, and any forms requested by the route or destination. If something looks incomplete, the desk will usually let you know what still needs attention so you can correct it before travel day.

Handled animals are cared for using calm, humane methods, and trained staff take a patient approach from the first check-in step through the rest of the process. A welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs so the animal's well-being stays central while paperwork is being checked. This helps the desk match the travel plan to the animal's needs rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all approach.

It helps to keep your papers together in one place and bring clear copies when you arrive. If your animal has special handling notes, feeding instructions, or travel support needs, include those with the other forms so staff can review everything together. Simple, complete paperwork often makes the day smoother for everyone involved.

If you are unsure whether a form is current or whether a detail should be added, the desk can guide you through the next step. That support is meant to reduce stress and prevent surprises. The aim is always to help you travel with confidence and help your animal stay as comfortable as possible.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel and our staff will guide you through the next step.
